name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Rotating Keychain
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality natural wood with a premium 4-layer structure.
    → Display Frame: 4 layered wooden frames (each layer approx. 2mm thickness) for durability and depth.
    → Inner Rotating Board: 1-layer wooden insert (2mm thickness) that smoothly rotates inside the frame.
    - Finished with precise laser cutting for clean edges and a smooth surface.
    - Comes with a sturdy metal keyring and chain for secure everyday use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes to suit different display needs:
    3 x 3 inches ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
    4 x 4 inches ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
    - Compact and lightweight, easy to carry while still large enough to showcase detailed designs and photos.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vibrant, crisp, and long-lasting colors. High-resolution details for personalized names, artwork, or icons.
    - Double-sided printing, ensuring a beautiful appearance from both the front and back.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Features a rotating inner photo board, allowing the image to spin smoothly within the wooden frame.
    - Perfect as:
    → A personalized keychain
    → A bag charm or accessory
    → A meaningful keepsake to carry cherished memories everywhere
    - Durable enough for everyday use while remaining stylish and decorative.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and unique gift for everyone. A heartfelt way to celebrate love, family, friendships, and special memories.
    - Ideal for Valentine’s Day, anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, Christmas, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, or just because.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 4-Layer Wooden Rotating Keychain

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
